label: D1 after consecutive unrewarded trials (loss streak), biased toward upcoming a2 choice
explanation: Fires only at D1 and only when the reward input is 0 (never after a rewarded trial, never at GO/D2). Within unrewarded D1s it is selective for loss streaks: two consecutive unrewarded trials lifts precision from 0.08 to 0.23 (recall 0.80); activation ramps along a streak (e.g. 0.04 -> 0.80 -> 1.00 of max on successive unrewarded D1s). It is strongly biased to D1s where the agent is about to choose a2 (89% of mass), i.e. upcoming switch to a2 / persistence on a2 after losses; adding action==2 (the agent own upcoming choice, legitimate) gives the recorded predicate (dev P 0.33, R 0.65, F1 0.44, mass recall 0.73). Rate rises strongly with trial index within the episode (near silent in trials 0-20, highest 80-99), and active steps have low model value (all below value 7.7). Precision remains low: many unrewarded-streak D1s are silent, so the predicate is incomplete; streak length, late-episode position and low value modulate it. No future reward/transition variable is used.
